**3h**

Importing mc (esp32c3), almost finished with schematic. Idea is a tamagotchi game with a bit of customization. I haven't done a project in a while and I'm on a new computer so I had to import the libraries, parts, etc which took a bit longer than expected. I hope to finish the schematic and pcb by the end of the day so I can begin working on the case design.
